title: Context-Aware Conditional Utility & Interaction Hardening
split_definition: train: tum_fr1_desk [0:40], val: tum_fr1_desk [41:60], test: tum_fr2_xyz
candidate_coverage_audit: AUDITED (27 exact groups g=(scene,frame,S_t) under context-centric generation, 100% exact candidate pool coverage |M_t|=|P_t|=20, missing=0, zero synthetic baseline fill. Confirms Case 1 rank stability at rho=0.9089, Kendall tau=0.8152, Overlap@5=82.2%)
scientific_conclusion: Case 1 / Case B: Contextual interaction exists in Gaussian utility (U*(i|S) != U*(i|empty), Gate 6A/6D pass), but within-frame candidate priority rank is substantially stable (rho=0.9089, Overlap@5=82.2% across 27 100%-coverage groups without synthetic fill). Consequently, Oracle Conditional achieves identical quality to Oracle Static (+0.00 context advantage), explaining why context-aware adaptive selection yields no statistically significant quality gain over static selection (p > 0.30, CI spans 0 across 5 seeds).
